title: Irish Crème Pastry
description: A classic Irish dessert featuring a silky crème filling encased in a flaky pastry crust. Perfect for snacking or serving at dinner parties.
instructions: Roll out the pastry crust to a thickness of 3mm.
Place the pastry in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Irish cream, silky creme, and granulated sugar.
Pour the creme mixture into the pastry crust.
Dot the top of the creme with the malty butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Allow the pastry to cool completely before serving.
